_comment: Symbol -> IG epic mapping for paper-traded equities / ETFs. Populate the `epic` field by hitting IG /gateway/deal/markets?searchTerm=<symbol> against demo creds; pick the epic whose instrumentName matches the listing you intend to trade. Entries with `epic: null` are intentionally unusable; the strategy will refuse to route them (IGEpicMissingError). See ig_epic_map.py for the loader contract. NOTE: epics below are IG-demo SHARE CFDs (24h US names), discovered + name-verified 2026-06-01 via /api/admin/ig/search. They match intraday_flat's share-based ATR sizing. The SPY/IWM/DIA/XLF ETF basket was dropped because IG demo only exposes those as index CFDs / options (unit + price-scale mismatch with the strategy).

META.notes: IG demo share CFD; epic retains legacy FB token, instrumentName confirms Meta. Verified 2026-06-01.

QQQ.notes: IG demo share CFD on the QQQ ETF; name-verified 2026-06-01.
